name: Post-T09 authoritative delivered-resource debit adapter

canonical_request.encoding: JSON array [transaction_id, recipe_id, target_id, source_state, target_state, integer revision, KINDS-ordered [kind, integer quantity] rows, progression_tags, presentation_key]
canonical_request.trust_boundary: Internal prepared-intent integrity token, not authentication for untrusted network callers.
canonical_request.next_revision: exactly prior revision + 1 with source_state equal to prior target_state
canonical_request.retention: Whitelisted required fields plus passed/authority_source/authority_applied/simulation_replayed; retained simulation_replayed is false; transaction IDs unique across retained targets.

authority.reason: T09 gather commits resources into carried simulation.inventory. The existing simulation deposit action moves carried resources into simulation.stored. T10-R06 requires delivered/available resources, so only stored is eligible for transformation cost.

validation_rules: Intent must be a dictionary with every required field present and non-empty where textual.
debits must be a non-empty dictionary containing only simulation KINDS with strictly positive whole quantities.
target_revision must be a positive whole integer.
authority_transaction_key must match the T10-prepared request-scoped key carried by the intent; simulation does not invent or rewrite it.
All requested debit quantities must be available in simulation.stored at the instant of first commit.
Validation failure or insufficient stored resources returns authority_applied=false and leaves all stored balances unchanged.
First success subtracts each exact debit quantity from simulation.stored once and returns a simulation-authoritative receipt preserving the T10 intent fields.
Retry with the exact latest authority_transaction_key for that target returns the prior authoritative receipt with simulation_replayed=true and performs zero debit.
A stale/lower-or-equal target revision with a different authority_transaction_key fails closed and performs zero debit.
A new higher revision for the target may replace its prior bounded debit receipt after successful debit.
The authoritative debit ledger is bounded to at most one latest receipt per T10 target.

bounded_idempotency.retention: latest successful authoritative debit receipt per target
bounded_idempotency.purpose: Survive T10 retry/crash window without double-debit while avoiding unbounded transaction history.

persistence.restore_behavior: missing field restores as empty for backward compatibility; malformed rows fail closed under the T10 integration test

integration_tests_after_t09: T10 preview affordability reads a copy of simulation.stored and never simulation.inventory.
A harvested-but-not-deposited T09 unit in simulation.inventory cannot satisfy T10 affordability.
After the existing deposit action moves that unit to simulation.stored, the same T10 preview may become eligible.
First transform debit subtracts exact costs from stored once.
Immediate duplicate/resubmission returns the same authoritative receipt and does not debit twice.
Crash/reload after simulation debit but before T10 acceptance restores the bounded simulation receipt and lets T10 close its pending transaction without a second debit.
Insufficient stored balance leaves stored and T10 world state unchanged.
Malformed/forged/stale authority keys fail closed without resource mutation.
Multiple different T10 targets may debit independently; each target retains at most one latest debit receipt.
T08 carried/source-to-actor presentation and conservation remain unchanged because T10 consumes only delivered stored resources.
